title: Choose the visual world
question: The re-roll assigned the Arati direction. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: Arati
options.lineage: The arati plate and its camphor flame, waved in clockwise circles at the close of every session
options.thesis: Listening is the flame circling; when the bhajan is known, its light passes over the screen and the words appear where it has been.
materials: camphor flame, blue at the base
options.viewport: A small brass ring with a white camphor flame, centred on deep indigo, is the Start button; found lyrics are revealed line by line by one sweep of its light, then the flame settles below them.
options.risk: Flame and brass slide easily into lamplight cliché and glow that washes out on a projector; the light must be crisp and brief, never ambient.

options.label: Teletext bhajan pages
options.thesis: Every bhajan is a numbered teletext page: double-height title, block-mosaic header, lyrics in a strict character grid on black.
options.case: Built for reading a TV across a room, so it suits the projector, but its retro-broadcast voice has no roots in a Sai hall.

options.label: Stitched bhajan book
options.thesis: The centre's bhajan binder as a loved object: a stitched leather cover opens and each bhajan is a linen page on a wooden shelf.
options.case: Devotees know the binder well, but leather, linen and wood textures get noisy and murky on a projector.

options.label: Glaze river
options.lineage: Heavily glazed cups on a kiln shelf
options.thesis: The lyrics run into place like molten glaze, pooling and stopping in deep colour fields that change with each bhajan.
options.case: The motion is beautiful, but running colour fights fast legibility, and the potter's world is foreign to the audience.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark lyric screen: white centred text, a simple fade between bhajans, a plain round button.
canonCard.viewport: Black screen, centred white sans-serif lyrics filling the frame, a pill-shaped button below.
